*   **Vertex Attribute Interpolation Error:** Standard vertex attribute interpolation does not produce correct per-pixel ray parameter values for MCOP.
*   **Performance:** At full resolution (1 ray/pixel, 1 sample/voxel), millions of rays require hundreds of steps, limiting interactive frame rates.
*   **Time Complexity:** Linear with respect to the number of samples per ray and the number of rays (pixels).
*   **Measured Performance:** The method was demonstrated on a display with 96 projectors.
